en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali Bin Al Nu’man, from Abu Hafs Al A’sha, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup>, said,

‘I heard him<sup>asws</sup> saying: ‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘The one who strives regarding a need of his brother but does not advise him, so he has betrayed Allah<sup>azwj</sup> and His<sup>azwj</sup> Rasool<sup>saww</sup>’.
en.sarwar: 1. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al- Hassan ibn Ali ibn al-Nu’man from abu Hafs al-‘A’sha’ who has said the following: “I heard abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) saying, ‘The Messenger of Allah has said, “Whoever works to help his brother (in belief), but is not sincere, has breached his trust with Allah and the Messenger of Allah.’”
